trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you earn. Finish the other 54 and it pops on its own — there is no extra task. Plan on roughly 200 hours; the long pole is A Long Road, the 100% checklist. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing. Play the story and it unlocks in the first minutes — it is the game's first trophy and cannot be missed. Sources: KeenGamer, Push Square.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story only; it pops when the chapter's last mission ends. Do the balcony meditation with Lucia first (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in Chapter 1 you cannot come back for. Sources: KeenGamer, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story only. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay, so a chapter save is your only way back. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story only. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story only. The eight big bank vaults open up in Chapter 4, through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — that is also when Maximum Withdrawal becomes possible. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Story only. After the credits the game drops you back into free-roam Leonida, so everything else can be cleaned up afterwards. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story only; it comes to you as the story unfolds. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. Story only. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. Story only. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. Story only. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Story only. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Story only. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story to see the checklist. It is a selection, not everything: 100 optional tasks, 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater finds, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 42 of 42 shooting-range golds, 42 of 42 drone trials, 300 of 397 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges. Expect about 100 hours after the story. Sources: PowerPyx, KeenGamer, Push Square.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts the game tracks — the 100% checklist wants 300 of 397, so keep chaining them while you travel instead of fast-travelling everywhere. Sources: KeenGamer, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each of the game's nine activity types — races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, pool, mini-golf, basketball, drone races and the rest. Sampling one of each is enough; you do not have to master any, and the game tracks which types you have tried under Progress. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Find the ranges around Leonida and beat each challenge's gold score — the 100% checklist also needs all 42, so this is not optional for the platinum. Use the weapon the challenge gives you and learn its recoil before chasing gold. Sources: KeenGamer, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 Top Fun spots, each with its own drone time trials — 42 trials in total, and the checklist wants all 42, so winning each location's race also clears a checklist line. Learn each course's gates before racing for the win. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — street, off-road, boat or air, whichever you like. The checklist wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots and challenge him — bring the best rod and tackle you have, and watch the line tension: reeling too hard snaps it. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any arcade cabinet, any game — finish one run through to the end. The checklist asks you to play all four arcade games, so try the rest while you are there. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the stranger quest-givers — follow his mission strand to its last mission. Quest-givers can go quiet during parts of the story but come back later, so if Andy vanishes, keep playing the story. Sources: KeenGamer, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as Andy: follow Kenton's strand to its end. Kenton's strand also feeds the treasure sets the checklist wants (5 of 7). Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission; like the other quest-givers he can be unavailable mid-story and returns later. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions are the side questlines marked around the map — finish any eight strands end to end. You do not need all of them: there are more strands than eight. Sources: KeenGamer, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its end. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its end. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditations at 10 spots, done with both characters where the spot allows. THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia says in the kitchen she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony at Jason's house. Follow her and accept — that meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot, and it is gone after Chapter 1. It is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. The checklist only needs 15 of 18. Sources: PowerPyx, vi.ki, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's Target Deck lists the animals to hunt — 15 target decks make up the checklist's hunting line. Track the target with the binoculars, then take the shot cleanly. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. The checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past three. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-phone app that scans vehicles and landmarks — point it at anything new and log it. Scan from the start of the story: the checklist also wants 100 scans, and 200 of 277 base-model vehicles. Sources: KeenGamer, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's checklist of feats — the game tracks 80 of them and the 100% checklist wants 70, so do the 50 easiest for this trophy and keep going to 70 for the platinum. Sources: KeenGamer, PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears. Use the countryside and water to break the search. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner beside you and never let the wanted level drop between them — plan a route of three close shops and keep moving. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Any 100 distinct vehicles count — the checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned with WAiNK, so scanning as you drive covers both. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-time aim mode — trigger it in a firefight with at least five enemies in view and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy shootout, not a quiet one. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off with it. Wait at the airport for a plane lining up, grab it and get airborne before security stops you. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos are found at military sites — grab one, survive the response, and put its cannon to work. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm — no witnesses, no cameras tripping. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big jobs — the eight large vaults open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4. Rob five and get clean away each time. The checklist wants all eight. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail every region until the whole map is uncovered — the game tracks which areas you have visited. Work outward from Vice City and check the map for fog left. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are nine gangs with illegal operations around Leonida — hit at least one operation per gang. The checklist's gang operations line wants 39 of 39, so you will pass through these anyway. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guide sites — try the beachfront bars at sunset. Sources: KeenGamer (method unconfirmed).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's glass front and out the other side. The exact showroom and method are still unconfirmed — try the big dealerships in Vice City. Sources: KeenGamer (method unconfirmed).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal the three key valuables at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and escape. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Raise the Strength stat to its maximum for both Jason and Lucia — gym work, swimming and melee all build it. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Perform 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile — crimes, good deeds and everything the profile tracks all count toward the 500. It accumulates naturally over a full playthrough. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. A hidden trophy whose unlock method is still unconfirmed by the guide sites — no reliable method is published yet. This guide will be updated when PowerPyx or KeenGamer confirm it. Sources: KeenGamer (unconfirmed), PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy whose unlock method is still unconfirmed. The name hints at something strange — possibly the UFO thread the community is chasing — but no guide has confirmed the trigger yet. Sources: KeenGamer (unconfirmed), PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Take enemies down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed — try a slow drive-by with a bat through a group on foot. Sources: KeenGamer (method being confirmed).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — fence them through your contacts until $250,000 is laundered. The checklist also needs $250,000 of marked bills fenced, so this clears itself during the 100% run. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food, cars — every dollar spent in a shop counts toward the $100,000. Save it for the cleanup phase and spend on things you actually want. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are eight purchasable garages across Leonida — buy them all. They are also where you store the vehicles for On the Spot. Sources: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app, register a vehicle you own, and repeat for ten different vehicles. Use the garages from Little Boxes to store them first. Sources: KeenGamer.
